headline: Light.
Leaf.
Season.
heroNote: Close looking at plants, and the odd photograph from further afield.
aboutBody: I spend a lot of time looking closely at plants — noticing when a flower is a few days from its best, or when the light finally reaches somewhere it usually doesn't. Most of what's here comes out of that habit, plus the odd photograph from travelling.
Shot on a Sony a7CR with a 24–105mm. Names are my best guess where I'm not certain of the exact species — corrections are always welcome.
